name: s01_cover_wordmark_text_7
text:
Smart City Flood Prediction
& Community Alert Platform

name: s02_heading_text_1
text: Limited data has to become a useful local decision.

name: s02_heading_text_2
text: Residents and municipal reviewers need location, evidence and a supported next step.

name: s02_question_0_text_9
text: Rainfall, terrain and drainage need a shared geographic context.

name: s02_question_1_text_14
text: A report needs a time, a location and a reviewable account of conditions.

name: s02_question_2_text_19
text: Warnings and routes must reflect current, verified evidence.

name: s02_problem_takeaway_text_20
text: Floodline brings these decisions into one traceable workflow.

name: s03_heading_text_2
text: Environmental warnings and observed road conditions keep their own meanings.

name: s03_environmental_text_8
text:
Rainfall + geographic features
→ interpretable warning rule

name: s03_community_text_12
text:
Private report + moderator review
→ current road-edge hazard

name: s04_heading_text_1
text: The map is the starting point.

name: s04_heading_text_2
text: A real capture of the delivered interface, with ward evidence beside the geography.

name: s05_heading_text_2
text: Checksums, explicit units and receipt-time availability make the input reproducible.

name: s05_data_flow_text_21
text:
Invalid records enter
a quarantine ledger

name: s05_receipt_timeline_text_23
text: What was available at issue time?

name: s05_receipt_timeline_text_31
text: This late record is excluded from the earlier snapshot.

name: s06_heading_text_1
text: GIS connects area context to a directed road graph.

name: s06_heading_text_2
text: The illustration uses the supplied synthetic geometry and road connections.

name: s06_gis_facts_text_97
text:
WGS84 for display
UTM 45N for distances

name: s06_gis_facts_text_98
text: Area susceptibility and road-water depth require different evidence.

name: s07_heading_text_1
text: An interpretable rule runs the demo.

name: s07_heading_text_2
text: The current index combines static susceptibility with recent rainfall.

name: s07_rule_features_text_15
text:
Imperviousness, drainage, relative
elevation and distance to water

name: s07_rule_features_text_19
text:
Three-hour rainfall scaled to
75 mm, capped at 100

name: s08_heading_text_1
text: The evidence is visible beside the map.

name: s08_heading_text_2
text: Risk words, timestamps and support flags help a resident interpret the display.

name: s09_heading_text_2
text: An observation stays private while its time, location and publication permissions are checked.

name: s09_resident_report_text_10
text:
Pending reports and images
remain private.

name: s10_heading_text_2
text: The recorded Library → Station comparison excludes a newly verified segment.

name: s10_route_conclusion_text_121
text:
The synthetic graph contains tied paths.
Only current, verified edge hazards are excluded.

name: s11_heading_text_1
text: Alerts remember consent, retries and expiry.

name: s11_heading_text_2
text: Persistent decisions prevent repeated processing from becoming repeated messages.

name: s11_alert_step_2_text_15
text:
Retries after 30 and 60 seconds;
3 attempts maximum.

name: s11_alert_step_3_text_18
text:
Withdrawal, expiry and resolved
hazards stop delivery.

name: s12_heading_text_2
text: 18 invented storms supply 624 usable rows; later storms remain held out.

name: s12_temporal_rule_text_21
text: Earlier events → later events. No row substitutes for an independent storm.

name: s13_heading_text_1
text: Higher recall brought more false positives.

name: s13_heading_text_2
text: Held-out synthetic rows compare the logistic candidate with a rainfall-only baseline.

name: s13_promotion_decision_text_18
text: Candidate remains unpromoted: it flags every test row.

name: s14_heading_text_2
text: The outage scenario preserves original issue times instead of refreshing stale evidence.

name: s14_outage_explanation_text_6
text:
cells become Unknown
during the recorded feed outage

name: s14_outage_explanation_text_10
text:
No invented observations
and no zero-rain substitution

name: s15_heading_text_1
text: The delivery is backed by inspectable checks.

name: s15_heading_text_2
text: Acceptance evidence for the synthetic v0.1.1 release, recorded 11 November 2026.

name: s15_acceptance_context_text_24
text:
320–1440 px captures, keyboard flows, consent,
moderation, routes, outage and recovery.

name: s15_acceptance_context_text_28
text:
10 clients / 20 loopback requests / SQLite.
Fresh Linux CI passes the automated workflow.

name: s16_heading_text_1
text: A focused demo follows six actions.

name: s16_heading_text_2
text: The same workflow can be shown live or explained using the preceding captures.

name: s16_demo_0_text_9
text:
Select an area and
check its evidence.

name: s16_demo_1_text_14
text:
Submit time, location
and an observation.

name: s16_demo_2_text_19
text:
Review evidence and
match a road segment.

name: s16_demo_4_text_29
text:
Opt in to a ward and
inspect delivery history.

name: s16_demo_5_text_34
text:
Run heavy rain, outage
and synthetic recovery.

name: s16_demo_launch_text_37
text: Launch start.bat beforehand. The console shows the selected address.

name: s17_heading_text_1
text: The path to a real pilot is clear.

name: s17_heading_text_2
text: The synthetic software workflow is delivered. Real-world readiness needs its own evidence.

name: s17_gate_0_text_21
text: Choose a pilot and licensed inputs

name: s17_gate_0_text_22
text: Audit source access, coverage and time semantics.

name: s17_gate_1_text_25
text: Use credible labels and separated held-out events.

name: s17_gate_2_text_28
text: GIS, usability, local language and team sign-offs.

name: s17_gate_3_text_31
text: Test PostGIS, hosting and real notification delivery.

name: s18_heading_text_1
text: Visible evidence supports useful local decisions.

name: s18_closing_claim_text_5
text: Trace the data. Review the observation. Explain the action.

name: s19_heading_text_1
text: Six responsibility areas connect the stack.

name: s19_heading_text_2
text: M1–M6 are proposed team labels from the pipeline; named contribution records remain to be completed.

name: s20_heading_text_1
text: Project requirements and evidence are linked.

name: s20_heading_text_2
text: Project-authored synthetic fixtures supply this release’s data.

name: s20_candidate_sources_text_28
text:
IMD • India-WRIS/CWC • NASA IMERG
